name: readable
description: No turning back: reading units (heading + first content, item + sub items, table or figure with its caption, introduction and notes, summary box, 붙임, last paragraph with 끝. and 결문; short sections and numbered lists when that leaves no page emptier) stay on one page; a table is not cut, or cut between rows with the header repeated and 3 rows at least in each part; pointers to other pages and footnotes that go on are reported; a table of a third of a page or more that would leave 40 mm or more empty above it is cut between rows instead of moved whole; a table kept whole holds its paragraph on its page (hold), so the text after it cannot move up before it; a table that goes over a page repeats a first row that looks like a header; free space goes into paragraph and table spacing.
